limits: Coverage is the official WiTW1943 campaign dated ground roster, not a claim to all archival historical forces.
Initial home/training divisions are not future reinforcements and have not been added under this metric.
New source-profile TOEs preserve entry composition but do not reconstruct later historical TOE handovers.
New arrivals, extended replacement categories and changed German mobilisation rate are statically checked, not a full runtime campaign.
Air-group reinforcements are audited separately; do not infer their completeness from1010 ground records.
Naval guns, ships, engineering/labour and generic support retain native type handling; national pools and strategic AI remain shared/unresolved.
Coverage applies to dated future air groups, not an audit restoring every initial air-force record.
New delayed air groups have no preloaded pilots; they use native arrival/replacement allocation, like existing delayed formations.
Aircraft pools and pilots remain subject to the shared native replacement system; arrivals require compressed runtime verification.
current_value_note: Earlier revision provenance. Current fuel, additional opening stocks, airborne readiness and ground morale/experience are in opening-readiness.json.
